goal: Keep Image2 and Dreamina authentication inside the NAS runtime, expose administrator-only device login controls, and make the selected image provider deterministic.

acceptance_criteria.description: The dashboard provider page exposes authenticated status, device login, login polling, connectivity checks, and logout for Codex OAuth (Image2) and Dreamina without returning access or refresh tokens.
All media login operations require the dashboard provider scope and inherit the NAS HTTP proxy environment.
The NAS image workspace exposes Auto, Image2, and Dreamina choices; explicit provider choices do not silently fall back to the other provider.
Codex OAuth, Dreamina CLI state, and the Linux Secret Service keyring are persisted by NAS volumes, while Codex and Dreamina subprocesses run through the AWS tunnel inherited by dc-agent.
